subject.title: [Feature]: Feishu: send text + multiple images as a single interactive card

question: Should Feishu automatically coalesce text or presentation plus image attachments into one interactive image card, or should this be an explicit opt-in send mode?
rationale: The code path is clear, but changing default message shape, fallback semantics, and the card sanitizer image surface is a product and channel-owner decision rather than a strict bug repair.

options.title: Feishu-scoped automatic image cards
options.body: Use a plugin-local controlled builder for text/presentation plus image attachments by default, with strict limits and sequential fallback preserved.

options.title: Explicit Feishu opt-in
options.body: Add a narrow Feishu send option or action parameter so existing media delivery stays unchanged unless the sender asks for a single image card.

options.title: Wait for generic presentation images
options.body: Defer this until a cross-channel presentation image block exists, accepting a larger protocol/API design before solving Feishu-specific demand.

recommendation.title: Feishu-scoped automatic image cards
recommendation.body: Use a plugin-local controlled builder for text/presentation plus image attachments by default, with strict limits and sequential fallback preserved.

likelyOwner.reason: The package metadata names this handle as the Feishu community maintainer, and the decision is Feishu-channel-specific.
